Promise.title: Cook better. Spend less. Save time.
Promise.subtitle: Our chefs save 2 hours and €3 a week on average with Cuisko.

Groceries.title: Track your groceries
Groceries.tip_send: Tap a suggestion below and Cuisko types it into the bar for you. In the app you simply type what you need, the way you'd say it: "500 g carrots", "2 onions". Cuisko understands.
Groceries.tip_buy: They're on your shopping list now. Back from the shop, tap each card to move it into your cellar, so Cuisko knows it's in your kitchen.
Groceries.tip_done: Your cellar is what Cuisko cooks from: it suggests recipes with what you have, and never asks you to buy what's already there.

Recipes.title: Ask Cuisko

Hints.cosy: Something cosy with what I have

Recipes.greeting: Hi! Tell me what you have or what you feel like eating, and I'll find the recipes.

Replies.potatoes-cream: Potatoes and cream, a winning pair. Here are two recipes made for them.
Replies.cosy: Something warm from what you already have: these three start from your kitchen.

PlanRecipe.title: Plan it
PlanRecipe.greeting: Tell me what you want to cook and when, and I'll put it on your week.
PlanRecipe.hint: Plan the gratin for two tomorrow night
PlanRecipe.reply: I planned the gratin for tomorrow night, for two. I checked what you already had in your cellar and added everything missing to your shopping list.

Steps.one: Slice the 3 potatoes thin and layer them in a buttered dish.
Steps.two: Pour the 20 cl of cream over, top with the 100 g of gruyère, and bake for an hour at 180 °C.

Week.tip_swap: Every dish is only a suggestion. Tap the arrows next to {{recipe}} to swap it for another recipe that fits your week.
Week.swapped: Your shopping list follows by itself: what the old dish needed is gone, and what the new one needs is added.
